issue: Startup or live refresh can capture old note terms, then publish them after a newer save_note has completed. Cleared terms can also reappear.

change.serialization: One Engine-owned mutex covers current Terms capture, hotwords.txt replacement and best-effort diagnostic replacement. No captured candidate list enters the gate.
change.lock_order: config (startup only) -> hotword_publication -> store; active/store guards are released by callers before publication; helper does not acquire config/active/notes_target.
change.resource_scope: No new worker, thread, model load, inference call, polling loop or dependency. Gate covers term extraction and bounded hotword publication only.

regression.method: Thread-local barrier after Terms capture and before file write. Probe the gate before starting the second writer only to choose a deadlock-free schedule; final pass criteria are actual save completion, joined threads, exact current DB wire/stats and unchanged test PCM.
regression.red: Behavior-preserving helper extraction, unused publication gate, unchanged old publication behavior. Four deterministic failures: ASTERLABS overwrites ORBITFORGE or empty context, through both startup-shared and live-refresh paths.
regression.green: Same hook position and assertions; acquire gate before Terms capture. All four regressions pass.
regression.timeout_limits: Channel receives have a 10-second failure bound; no timeout is accepted as evidence of serialization. Thread joins do not constitute a separate hard wall-clock deadline.
regression.audio: Public synthetic bytes used only to assert no mutation; no native capture/decoder started.

review.independent_lock_order: No inverse store/active/config/notes_target edge found. Both production call sites use the helper.
review.test_review: No production bypass found. Lock-state observation selects schedule only; final assertions use current persisted data.

limits: Guarantee is within one Engine process. The two files are individually replaced, not one transaction; diagnostic JSON remains best effort.
Not a native decoding or microphone test, acoustic recall gain, minutes quality gain or whole-device performance benchmark.
Existing Q9 and Q16 quality failures remain open. No new model run, installer, default model/backend change or release.
Development checks are scoped to affected paths; no local full corpus or full package rebuild was repeated.
